title: Why I Cook With Induction
summary: Chef Jon Kung explains why he cooks almost exclusively on induction, citing fast heating, cleanliness and precise temperature control. He shows a rounded induction wok burner.
why: HN points to it in gas-versus-induction threads as a professional chef making the positive case, including for wok cooking.

quote.text: Jon Kung makes the positive case for an induction wok better than I can
